The cobra poison in this flask is very potent. Even inhaling it would be dangerous. It leaks a bit and will evaporate shortly.
This small ritual flask is used to gather potent snake poison.
It is charged with the memories of the Ambassador of Rathleton.
Some honey palm blossoms are still floating in it, intensifying the sweet flavour.
It smells sickly sweet.
This lamp oil is highly flammable and evaporates quickly.
It is carved from sequoia wood.
It is slightly tarnished.
It is smoothly polished and cool to the touch.
It is composed of many small shards.
You can find the gryphon mask high in the mountains. It will open the gryphon-guarded door.
The ivory mask is under the ankh mosaic in the library. Put the missing emerald in the tile to open the hidden compartment. This mask will open the ivory-adorned doors.
The silver mask is hidden in the ruins of Nuur. It will open the silver-veined doors.
The mirror mask is hidden in a tomb near the northern oasis. It will open the mirror-behung door.
It is a present you received from the medusa Alyxo.
It hopped out of the mouth of recently killed goanna. It is barely alive and looks very scared.
It is roughly woven.
Something has been planted in there, but you cannot see what it is yet.
